title: Sign in and reach the task list
description: This test verifies that a technician can sign in with valid credentials and arrive at the assigned task list.

steps.description: Navigate to /masuk
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the task list is displayed
Verify assigned tasks are displayed

title: Submit a completed task successfully
description: This verifies that a technician can complete a task and submit it successfully, returning to the active task list without the task remaining there.

steps.description: Navigate to /masuk
Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} into the username field
Fill in {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the first assigned task
Fill a valid value into the required fields on the task form
Submit the task form
Verify the user returns to the task list
Verify the submitted task no longer appears in the active task list

title: Submit a completed task and remove it from active work
description: This test verifies that a technician can complete a task submission successfully and the task disappears from the active task list afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /masuk
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click a task row
Complete the required task fields
Submit the task
Verify the task list is displayed
Verify the submitted task is no longer listed among active work

title: Autosave text and date fields in a task
description: This test verifies that a technician can enter form data in a task and the changes are preserved by offline-first autosave.

steps.description: Navigate to /masuk
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click a task row
Fill in a text field with a unique task note
Fill in a valid date field
Verify the entered task note is preserved
Verify the date value is preserved

title: Complete task fields and save progress

steps.description: Navigate to /masuk

title: See offline queue status while editing a task
